question: Should generic `tool-progress` metadata be a supported public Plugin SDK contract, or remain an internal bundled-runtime signal?
rationale: Both boundaries are mechanically viable, but accepting permanent producer and channel-consumer semantics for third-party plugins requires maintainer API intent.

options.title: Document the public contract
options.body: Keep the exports and define eligible producers, transient-only semantics, terminal-output behavior, and channel-consumer expectations with focused contract coverage.

options.title: Internalize the signal
options.body: Remove the public exports and carry progress intent through an internal bundled seam limited to current producers and Slack.

recommendation.title: Document the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the exports and define eligible producers, transient-only semantics, terminal-output behavior, and channel-consumer expectations with focused contract coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The current-main history connects this person to the central Codex projector and existing progress-marker integration involved in the boundary choice.
